note: Recorded answers are hand-written fixtures that exercise the contract (valid and invalid). npm run eval:live measures real providers against the same inputs.

input.title: Take the Riyadh role
input.expected: Harder first six months, better money, home every other weekend
input.outcome: Money better, but home once a month at best. Kids noticed.

recorded.lesson: You priced the salary carefully but guessed at the travel; check the hardest cost before you say yes.

input.title: Buy the car now vs wait for 2027 model
input.expected: Prices go up next year, so buying now saves money
input.outcome: Prices dropped 8% in March. Should have waited.

recorded.lesson: You felt 80% sure about a price forecast — next time start from how often such forecasts are right.

input.title: Start the morning run
input.expected: I will run 3 times a week by December
input.outcome: Ran 3 times a week most weeks, missed during Ramadan

recorded.lesson: A small, fixed slot beat motivation; plan the breaks, like Ramadan, before they arrive.

input.title: Switch bank to get 2% cashback
input.expected: Save around AED 150 a month
input.outcome: Saved about AED 90 a month, fees ate the rest

recorded.lesson: You counted the cashback and skipped the fees — read the fee table before switching for a perk.

input.title: Kid ko naya school
input.expected: Better teachers, thoda zyada fees but worth it
input.outcome: Teachers achhe hain, commute 40 min extra, bacha thak jata hai

recorded.lesson: You weighed teachers and fees but not the daily commute; walk the route at school time before choosing.

input.title: Learn Python on weekends
input.expected: Finish the course by end of November
input.outcome: Finished in time, used it at work twice already

recorded.lesson: Weekend blocks worked when tied to a real use at work — keep learning attached to a job you need done.

input.title: Say no to the extra project
input.expected: Less stress, boss slightly unhappy for a week
input.outcome: Boss was fine, stress went down a lot

recorded.lesson: You overestimated how much a clear no would cost you; say it earlier next time.

input.title: Move to a cheaper flat
input.expected: Save AED 2,000 a month, small hassle
input.outcome: Saved AED 2,000 but moving cost AED 6,500

recorded.lesson: You were right on the rent and silent on the move; count one-off costs against the first months of savings.

input.title: Invest bonus in index fund
input.expected: Grows steadily, no need to watch it
input.outcome: Down 4% after three months, did not touch it

recorded.lesson: Leaving it alone was the plan and you held to it — judge it on the process, not three months.

input.title: Visit parents in Pune for Diwali
input.expected: Tiring but worth it
input.outcome: Exactly that. Worth it.

recorded.lesson: When the reason is people, trust the pull — you were right to go.
